25.
(1) In determining the appropriate sentence for any
offence  under  this  Act,  the  court  shall  have  regard  to  the
sentence prescribed for such offence in the Penal Code or
any  other  law  and  the  decisions  laid  down  by  courts  of
appellate jurisdiction with regard to the sentencing policies
on the imposition of punishments.
(2)  Due regard shall also be given to aggravating and
mitigating circumstances attending each offence.
(3)    The  Judicial  Service  Commission  may  issue
guidelines  under  this  Act  with  respect  to  the  sentencing
policy.
